    s.School,
    CONCAT(s.Street, ', ', s.City, ', ', s.State, ' ', s.Zip) AS FullCommunicationAddress
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.SchoolType LIKE '%High Schools%'
    AND f.County = 'Monterey'
    AND f.FreeMealCountAges5_17 > 800;
```
